records.key:
Straight down descends to one point on the boundary and stays pointed at it — the steadiest picture, and what the published settings use.

Search as it goes periodically scores several directions around the centre by the set boundary they contain and moves the camera toward the highest score. The camera movement is visible; the Steering control below sets how far each move reaches.

Tour the interesting places measures the view as it descends and glides toward the part with the most colours in it, never toward a single-colour patch. The camera eases in and out of every move and turns away before the detail runs out, and at the end of a dive it glides back up. Dragging the view stops the tour; Help ▸ Window ▸ Restart the background hands the camera back to it.
records.source:
Straight down descends to one point on the boundary and stays pointed at it — the steadiest picture, and what the published settings use.

Search as it goes periodically scores several directions around the centre by the set boundary they contain and moves the camera toward the highest score. The camera movement is visible; the Steering control below sets how far each move reaches.

Tour the interesting places measures the view as it descends and glides toward the part with the most colours in it, never toward a single-colour patch. The camera eases in and out of every move and turns away before the detail runs out, and at the end of a dive it glides back up. Dragging the view stops the tour; Help ▸ Window ▸ Restart the background hands the camera back to it.
records.translation:
Tout droit descend vers un point de la frontière et reste pointé dessus — l’image la plus stable, et celle qu’utilisent les réglages publiés.

Chercher en chemin évalue périodiquement plusieurs directions autour du centre selon la frontière de l'ensemble qu'elles contiennent et déplace la caméra vers le score le plus élevé. Le mouvement de la caméra est visible ; le réglage Direction ci-dessous fixe la portée de chaque mouvement.

Visiter les endroits intéressants mesure la vue pendant la descente et glisse vers la partie qui a le plus de couleurs, jamais vers une plage d’une seule couleur. La caméra entre et sort en douceur de chaque mouvement et se détourne avant que le détail ne s’épuise, puis, à la fin d’une plongée, remonte en glissant. Faire glisser la vue arrête la visite ; Aide ▸ Fenêtre ▸ Redémarrer l’arrière-plan lui rend la caméra.
